title: Mongolia
text: This page focuses on Mongolia’s climate pattern across the year.

title: Mongolia
text:
City Life & Outdoor Culture
Most Mongolians live in urban areas, and Ulaanbaatar is a busy city shaped by the same dramatic seasons shown in the chart. Daily life includes apartment neighborhoods, universities, offices, restaurants, shopping districts, and long winter commutes. Residents adapt to the cold with insulated buildings, warm layers, and indoor gathering places rather than treating winter as a reason to stop city life.
The outdoors are also part of the rhythm of city life, especially in summer. People in Ulaanbaatar can leave the city for the Bogd Khan mountains to hike, enjoy wide views, and spend time in nature. That creates a different warm-weather pattern from Sarasota, where residents often use the beach, waterfront, and nearby parks for swimming, walking, and relaxing outdoors.

Ulaanbaatar in winter: Cold temperatures shape transportation, clothing, heating, and the amount of time people spend outside, but cafes, markets, schools, and cultural spaces remain active.
Ulaanbaatar in summer: Warmer, drier weather makes hiking and trips into the surrounding mountains popular weekend activities.
Sarasota in warm weather: Beach visits and waterfront activities are an everyday part of outdoor life, supported by a warmer climate and access to the Gulf coast.

title: Mongolia
text:
Key pattern
Mongolia has a much colder winter and a sharper seasonal temperature swing than Sarasota. Rainfall is relatively low overall, but the climate still shows a clear warm-season pulse.

title: Sarasota’s ‘Freezing’ Winter
text:
Sarasota residents sometimes describe winter days as freezing. But “cold” depends on what your body is used to. For someone from Mongolia, a Sarasota winter day can look much more like a mild or even summery day at home.
Choose any Sarasota day below. Winter dates are grouped at the top of the menu so you can focus on the days Sarasota residents may call “freezing.” The comparison finds the day in Ulaanbaatar with the closest daily average air temperature.

title: UB Weather Dashboard
text: How does the world’s coldest national capital compare to sunny Florida? Explore multi-year temperature and rainfall patterns between Sarasota, FL and Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

title: UB Weather Dashboard
text:
Hourly Temperature Comparison


                            
                                            


Click any year button above to jump directly into that year, or click All to view the full timeline. You can also drag the timeline slider below the chart to zoom into specific months or seasons. Ulaanbaatar drops far below 32°F in winter and rises to warm summer highs, while Sarasota stays relatively mild all year.

title: UB Weather Dashboard
text:
Hourly Rainfall Comparison


                            
                                            


Click any year button or use the timeline slider to compare rainfall patterns across single years or the entire timeline. Ulaanbaatar has a distinct summer rainfall pulse, while Sarasota shows heavier rainfall across more of the year.

title: About
text:
Email: a.davaadorj30@ncf.edu
GitHub: @angeladavdrj
Final project repo: sarasota-mongolia
New College of Florida: ncf.edu

I am from Mongolia and now live in Sarasota, Florida. This project brings those two places together, using weather data to explore how different their seasons, temperatures, and rainfall patterns can be.



My work focuses on translating raw environmental data into clear, readable stories about climate and place. This website compares the daily weather record of Sarasota, Florida, and Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia to highlight differences in temperature, seasonality, and rainfall across the same time window.

title: About
text:
Data Source
This project uses historical hourly weather data from Meteostat, a public weather data service that aggregates observational records from meteorological stations around the world. The analysis compares hourly temperature and precipitation observations from Sarasota, Florida (station KSRQ0) and Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia (station 44292) over a shared multi-year period. The data were accessed through the Meteostat Python API and then cleaned and visualized for comparison in this website. For more information, see Meteostat, the Meteostat API documentation, and the station records for Sarasota and Ulaanbaatar.
